purpose: Map researched editorial content onto the existing Agrico university detail structure before any CMS import.
publication: No live website or CMS records are changed by this content package.
identity_rule: The /university/ route family also hosts 19 independent college profiles. Preserve the college name, affiliation and private_college identity; do not rename them as universities.

mappings.existing_target: University name, slug, city, state, ownership_type; UniversityModel identity hero
mappings.action: Map taxonomy relations to real CMS records rather than treating labels as relation ids.

mappings.existing_target: University establish/established_year and address; University at a glance
mappings.action: Import verified facts only; retain nulls as unpublished optional facts.

mappings.existing_target: UniversityModel description, authored content section and University highlights
mappings.action: Bind institution-specific text in the detail adapter; current generic fallback prose should yield to this content.

mappings.existing_target: Program records, university/programme relations, searchable DetailExplorer rows
mappings.action: Create or match one canonical programme per qualification; retain institution-specific eligibility, admission route and accreditation scope.

mappings.existing_target: University program_fees / programme offering price and note
mappings.action: Preserve the fee period, source year, charge scope and scholarship conditions. Do not import a total or a scholarship-adjusted amount as an unconditional annual tuition price.

mappings.existing_target: University admissions section and Journey content
mappings.action: Add content binding for institution-specific eligibility, steps, documents, dates and official admission links. Retain historical dates as historical context.
Replace the generic checklist with verified institutional facilities and practical-learning copy when integrating.
Keep award eligibility, exclusions and source year; no individual scholarship promise.

mappings.existing_target: Authored career-support section and recruiter cards
mappings.action: Carry metric reporting year and exact programme/campus/institution scope. Do not promote a university-wide statistic to agriculture-specific outcomes.
Retain dates and programme/unit scope as structured fields. Recheck renewal before any claim after a printed expiry; avoid one blanket ICAR badge for all degrees.
Import only sourced people/roles; no default staff or invented portraits.
Bind per-institution answers; do not reuse the generic FAQ set for every profile.
Use unique meta titles and descriptions. Canonical URLs are configured by the application, not scraped from source publishers.

Local originals and source/alt metadata are prepared in media-manifest.json. Resolve cms-media-import-plan.json upload keys to media IDs for logo, card_logo and image. Secondary photos remain gallery candidates. See recorded source/rights and native-resolution notes.
Match actual published CMS slugs before showing links; the prepared selection is editorial, not an affiliation.
Retain outside student-facing marketing copy. Resolve material unknowns before publishing their factual fields.
Import all ten structured tab documents with their parent overview. Preserve each tab_slug, canonical path, sections, FAQs, media and sources; do not flatten the ten documents into the overview.

local_implementation.tab_navigation: Eleven URL-based pages per institution, each with its own content, TOC and canonical URL
local_implementation.indexing_policy: 123 evidence-poor tabs remain noindex/follow; preserve supplied per-document indexing decisions.
local_implementation.structured_content_role: Research, metadata, regeneration and offline fallback; marked CMS HTML overrides the displayed body.
